name: veo_generate
description: Off in this version of Montaj: Google shut down Veo 3.1 on 2026-10-22, so the step fails with video_off. Use kling_generate, seedance_generate or kinovi_generate. Generate video with sound via Veo (Google) on the user's own Gemini key. Clips always have sound and are 4, 6 or 8 s. Mode follows the inputs: text only (t2v), --image for image-to-video (i2v), --image with --last-frame for first and last frame, --ref-image for up to 3 reference images (r2v). Project-aware mode: pass --project-id and --scene-id and the step reads the project, composes the prompt, generates, and saves the clip to tracks[0].

params.name: prompt
params.description: Scene description. Required in standalone mode. Ignored in project-aware mode.

params.name: out
params.description: Output .mp4 path. Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: image
params.description: Starting image (first frame). PNG, JPEG or WebP. Mutually exclusive with --ref-image.

params.name: ref-image
params.description: Reference image (repeatable, up to 3). Needs an 8 s clip. Not on the lite model. Mutually exclusive with --image. Ignored in project-aware mode.

params.name: duration
params.description: Clip length in seconds: 4, 6 or 8. 1080p, 4k and reference images need 8. Ignored in project-aware mode (read from the scene).

params.name: aspect-ratio
params.description: 16:9|9:16. Default: 16:9 for a landscape --image, 9:16 otherwise. Ignored in project-aware mode (read from the storyboard).

params.name: resolution
params.description: 720p|1080p|4k. 1080p and 4k need an 8 s clip. The lite model has no 4k.

params.name: model
params.description: veo-3.1-generate-preview is the default and best model. fast and lite cost less per second.

params.name: project-id
params.description: Project ID. With --scene-id, enables project-aware mode.

params.name: scene-id
params.description: Scene ID within the storyboard. Requires --project-id.
